The provided C candidates focus on 'Net income' for the 'All Other-Managed Basis' (c_2024_7_D118) and 'Banking' (c_2024_7_D038) segments. comparisons.peer_summary: Operating expenses decreased 2% to $33.77 billion in 2024, aided by lower CIE commercial real estate impairments and prior year one-time charges like the GreenSky write-down, partially offset by higher compensation and transaction expenses, resulting in an efficiency ratio improvement to 63.1% from 74.6%.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and GS report on their overall non-interest/operating expense trends for 2024, but they exhibit opposite directions and drivers. MS Investment Management reported a 4% increase in non-interest expenses to $4,724 million, driven by higher compensation and non-compensation costs. In contrast, GS reported a 2% decrease in total operating expenses to $33.77 billion. GS's decrease was primarily due to lower commercial real estate impairments and prior year one-time charges (like GreenSky write-downs), although GS also noted that these decreases were partially offset by higher compensation and benefits expenses. Thus, while both faced higher compensation pressures, GS's total expense profile improved due to significant non-compensation items, whereas MS's segment expenses rose.

sentences.text: Non-interest expenses of $4,724 million in 2024 increased 4% from the prior year, as a result of higher Non-compensation and Compensation and benefits expenses.

Operating expenses were $33.77 billion for 2024, 2% lower than 2023, reflecting decreases driven by significantly lower expenses, including impairments, related to commercial real estate in consolidated investment entities (CIEs) and other significant expenses recognized in the prior year, including the write-down of identifiable intangible assets related to GreenSky Holdings, LLC (GreenSky), an impairment of goodwill related to Consumer platforms and the FDIC special assessment fee.
These decreases were partially offset by higher compensation and benefits expenses (reflecting improved operating performance) and higher transaction based expenses.
